name.text: Double line graph: blue and red pens used by grades 7 to 11

questiontext.text:
The double line graph shows the number of blue pens and the number of red pens used by students in grades 7 to 11.

[[jsxgraph width="640px" height="480px"]] var B = {#B#}, R = {#R#}, TT = {#TT#}; var uu = ({#uu#}), Ytop = ({#Ytop#}), ut = ({#ut#}), Ytop2 = ({#Ytop2#}); var gT = ({#gmaxT#}), gD = ({#gmaxD#}); var US = uu, YT = Ytop; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-1.9, YT + 1.9 * US, 6.9, -2.9 * US], axis: false, grid: false, keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); var ppx = board.unitX, ppy = board.unitY; /* pixels per data unit, to place labels a fixed number of pixels from the axes */ var boxCss = 'background:#ffffff; padding:1px 5px; border:1px solid #999999; border-radius:3px;'; var gi, i; /* grid: a vertical line at each grade, a horizontal line at every grid value */ for (gi = 1; gi != 6; gi++) { board.create('segment', [ [gi, 0], [gi, YT] ], {strokeColor: '#d4d4d4', strokeWidth: 1, fixed: true, highlight: false, layer: 0}); } for (gi = 1; gi != YT / US + 1; gi++) { board.create('segment', [ [0, gi * US], [5.9, gi * US] ], {strokeColor: '#d4d4d4', strokeWidth: 1, fixed: true, highlight: false, layer: 0}); } /* axes start at zero; board.create('text', [gi, -9 / ppy, '' + (gi + 6)], {fixed: true, highlight: false, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 14}); } for (gi = 1; gi != YT / US + 1; gi++) { board.create('segment', [ [0, gi * US], [-6 / ppx, gi * US] ], {strokeColor: '#222222', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}); board.create('text', [-10 / ppx, gi * US, '' + (gi * US)], {fixed: true, highlight: false, anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14}); } board.create('text', [3, -44 / ppy, 'Grade'], {fixed: true, highlight: false, anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 17}); board.create('text', [-1.8, YT + 1.7 * US, 'Number of pens used'], {fixed: true, highlight: false, anchorX: 'left', fontSize: 17}); /* the double line graph: blue = solid line with circles, red = dashed line with squares, so the two can be told apart without colour */ for (i = 0; i != 4; i++) { board.create('segment', [ [i + 1, B[i]], [i + 2, B[i + 1]] ], {strokeColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 3, fixed: true, highlight: false, layer: 4}); board.create('segment', [ [i + 1, R[i]], [i + 2, R[i + 1]] ], {strokeColor: '#c62828', strokeWidth: 3, dash: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false, layer: 4}); } for (i = 0; i != 5; i++) { board.create('point', [i + 1, B[i]], {name: '', size: 5, face: 'circle', strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', fixed: true}); board.create('point', [i + 1, R[i]], {name: '', size: 5, face: 'square', strokeColor: '#c62828', fillColor: '#c62828', fixed: true}); Total number of blue pens = [[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]]
